name: Fortune Parts Industry Public Company Limited
summary: Fortune Parts Industry Public Company Limited manufactures and distributes automotive replacement parts in Thailand, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and internationally. The company operates in three segments: Domestic Sales, Export Sales, and Services. It offers plastic injection parts, such as grilles, bumpers, H/L doors, valance panels, side bumpers and corners, and other plastic parts; and lamp and mirror parts, including head, corner, tail, side, front, reflector tail, and fog lamps, as well as automotive mirrors. The company also provides metal stamping parts comprising stampings for fenders, hoods, radiator supports, valance panels, doors, tail gates, roll bars, front guards, and bumpers; coolant parts, such as radiators, condensers, evaporators, and inter coolers; and suspension parts, including center bearings, engine mountings, bushings, ball joints, shock absorbers, and upper and lower arms. In addition, it offers engine and brake parts, including disc brake pads, brake shoes and wheels, water pumps, starters, and alternators; and cables and hoses comprising accelerator, speedometer, hand brake, clutch, and hook lock control cables, as well as brake, fuel, and hydraulic hoses. Further, the company provides mold design and making services; plastic injection molding services; plastic chrome plating services; and plastic painting, finishing, and assembly services, as well as dipping services. Its products are primarily used in pick-up vehicles, trucks, and passenger cars. Fortune Parts Industry Public Company Limited was founded in 1991 and is based in Lam Luk Ka, Thailand.
